direction: Negative percentages mean less frame time, not the same numerical FPS gain.
decision: Assess repeatability across both fixed audits, all six ratios and descriptive paired-log uncertainty. Integrate only a reproducible, overall acceptable gain across BMW and T-80 off/2x/4x; double-digit improvement is a target, not an assumed result. Preserve every attempt; no tuning or early stopping on a favorable pair.
